degree_rationale: The Five Mysteries (peace, right hand, embrace, obeisance, ordination) by which the First Man went forth and returned. These are mysteries that ILLUMINATE the celestial drama of departure and reception — the kiss, blessing, crowning of the Son returning to the Father.
direction_rationale: Marks the south-turn at the celestial level: the originating essences are now seen in their luminous, recognized form — the love-greetings, the embraces, the splendid ordination. This is wisdom illumining what the east laid down.
grand_man_function: Celestial face-and-eyes — the inmost recognition mysteries of love (peace, kiss, blessing).
title: The Five Mysteries (peace, salutation, kiss, hands, chirotonia) by which the First Man returned
